requirements.title: Argument, host, and construct association have associating and pre-existing entities
requirements.source: S19.5.5 p1,p2,p3,p4, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF561.
requirements.definition: Argument, host, and construct association establish an associating entity whose selected properties become those of a pre-existing entity; the pre-existing and associating entities are identified for each association form.

pending.argument-association-entity-roles: Call a subroutine with integer actual initialized to -777 and dummy INTENT(INOUT); assign dummy=4321 and assert the actual becomes 4321 after return.
pending.host-association-entity-roles: Contained procedure assigns host integer h from -777 to 765 and the host instance asserts h==765 after the call.
pending.construct-association-entity-roles: ASSOCIATE(alias => target) with target initialized to -777, assign alias=975, and assert target==975 after END ASSOCIATE.

Clause 19 sibling storage-status sections are retained as cross-references; coarray and image facets remain out of scope by user decision. Cross-reference owners opened and confirmed on main for the rules named here: doc/catalogues/equivalence_statement_8_10_1_1.json, doc/catalogues/common_statement_8_10_2_2.json, and doc/catalogues/storage_association_8_10_3.json cover EQUIVALENCE/COMMON storage-association source rules; doc/catalogues/numeric_storage_size_16_10_2_23.json, doc/catalogues/character_storage_size_16_10_2_5.json, and doc/catalogues/file_storage_size_16_10_2_11.json cover ISO_FORTRAN_ENV storage-size constants and their processor-dependent bit-count latitude; doc/catalogues/size_specifier_12_6_2_16.json and doc/catalogues/waiting_for_pending_data_transfer_12_7_1.json cover SIZE= and asynchronous wait timing; doc/catalogues/stat_specifier_9_7_4.json and doc/catalogues/errmsg_specifier_9_7_5.json cover STAT= and ERRMSG= allocation specifiers; doc/catalogues/additional_semantics_for_do_concurrent_constructs_11_1_7_5.json covers DO CONCURRENT LOCAL_INIT and related processor-latitude splits; doc/catalogues/intent_attribute_8_5_10.json, doc/catalogues/protected_attribute_8_5_15.json, and doc/catalogues/pure_procedures_15_7.json cover constraints that consume variable-definition and pointer-association contexts. No doc/catalogues/19.5.2.2 owner exists on main in this worktree, so 19.6.8 carries its own concrete ASSOCIATED-status positive plans for pointer-association contexts rather than deferring to that missing owner.

requirements.title: Association establishment transfers pointer, allocatable, ordinary, and pointer-dummy properties
requirements.definition: Established association gives the associating entity the stated pointer status and target, allocatable allocation state and properties, ordinary definition/value/dynamic type, bounds where required, and pointer-dummy association to a nonpointer actual.

pending.pointer-status-target-and-bounds-transfe: Associate a pointer actual p(3:4) with target values [31,32] to a pointer dummy, initialize result sentinels to -777, and assert ASSOCIATED(dummy,p), LBOUND(dummy,1)==3, UBOUND(dummy,1)==4, and dummy values [31,32].
pending.allocatable-status-bounds-type-params-de: Pass an allocated character(len=4) allocatable array with bounds -1:0 and values ["abCD","efGH"] to an allocatable dummy; inside the callee assert ALLOCATED(dummy), bounds -1:0, LEN(dummy)==4, and exact values, with a SELECT TYPE companion for dynamic type.
pending.ordinary-definition-value-dynamic-type-a: ASSOCIATE alias => integer target(-2:-1) initialized to [7,8], set sentinel bounds to -777, and assert LBOUND(alias,1)==-2, UBOUND(alias,1)==-1, and alias values [7,8].
pending.pointer-dummy-associated-with-nonpointer: Pass TARGET integer actual initialized to -777 to a pointer dummy INTENT(INOUT), assign dummy pointer target to 2468, and assert the actual becomes 2468 plus ASSOCIATED(dummy) inside the callee.
